display.purpose: The artist name, heading a result. The hero headline runs on its own larger clamp.

headline.purpose: The top track title — the answer, and the largest thing in the result zone.

body.purpose: Reading text, ledes, meta lines. Keep prose to 48–75ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase card labels, source headers, the hero eyebrow; and, at weight 600 with tabular-nums, every comparable figure.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: The default resting glow beneath result cards and tiles — present but nearly subliminal.

shadows.name: artwork-lift
shadows.purpose: A deeper shadow that makes album artwork feel physically raised off the card.

shadows.name: search-float
shadows.purpose: Floats the search field above the hero.

shadows.name: accent-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The amber glow on focused controls — the booth's dial lighting up.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: The house curve: the result reveal and every lift/settle transition.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and color state changes on controls.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: The first result only: opacity 0->1 with a 14px translateY settle. Later results hand off by scroll and focus instead.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: The loading sweep across skeleton bars — skeletons, never a spinner.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The rise, the shimmer, and the reveal scroll all collapse to a crossfade or an instant jump.

motion.name: reveal-scroll
motion.purpose: How every result after the first arrives: the reader is carried to the answer. Jumps instantly under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: stale-dim
motion.purpose: The outgoing answer while the next loads: dimmed but still holding the page's height.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The search action — the one amber element on the hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.13 74)); color: var(--on-accent, oklch(18% 0.02 262)); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-dim, oklch(72% 0.12 74)); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(81% 0.13 74 / 0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The hero's floating pill: leading glyph, transparent input, amber submit. The whole field lights up on focus.
components.html: <form class="ds-search"><svg class="ds-search-glyph" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"></path></svg><input class="ds-search-input" type="text" placeholder="Try Radiohead, Sade, Fela Kuti…" /><button class="ds-search-submit" type="submit">Search</button></form>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface, oklch(19% 0.012 262)); border: 1px solid var(--border-2, oklch(34% 0.014 262)); box-shadow: 0 18px 50px -20px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.7); transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent-dim, oklch(72% 0.12 74)); box-shadow: 0 18px 50px -20px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.7), 0 0 0 4px oklch(81% 0.13 74 / 0.12); } .ds-search-glyph { color: var(--faint, oklch(50% 0.012 260)); flex: none; } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: none; border: none; outline: none; color: var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.008 85)); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, oklch(50% 0.012 260)); } .ds-search-submit { height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.13 74)); color: var(--on-accent, oklch(18% 0.02 262)); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-search-submit:hover { background: var(--accent-dim, oklch(72% 0.12 74)); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-search-submit:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(81% 0.13 74 / 0.12); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-search { flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 12px; } .ds-search-glyph { display: none; } .ds-search-input { flex-basis: 100%; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-search-submit { flex: 1; } }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Static genre descriptors under an artist name. Not an interactive filter.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(81% 0.13 74 / 0.08); border: 1px solid oklch(81% 0.13 74 / 0.32); color: var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.13 74)); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Result Card
components.description: The answer surface: mono label, serif title, mono figure. The track card carries the larger cover and the larger title; the album card sits below it.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, oklch(19% 0.012 262)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(28% 0.012 262)); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -30px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.8); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--faint, oklch(50% 0.012 260)); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; color: var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.008 85)); font-family: var(--font-display, "Instrument Serif", Georgia, serif); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-card-meta { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted, oklch(67% 0.015 260)); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-card-em { color: var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.008 85)); } .ds-card-figure { margin: 16px 0 0; color: var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.13 74)); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Similar Artist Tile
components.description: The doorway to the next search — a whole tile that is one tap to the next artist. Lifts to Panel Raised on hover.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, oklch(19% 0.012 262)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(28% 0.012 262)); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -30px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.8); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tile:hover { background: var(--surface-2, oklch(23% 0.014 262)); border-color: var(--border-2, oklch(34% 0.014 262)); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-dim, oklch(72% 0.12 74)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(81% 0.13 74 / 0.12); } .ds-tile:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-tile-name { color: var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.008 85)); font-family: var(--font-display, "Instrument Serif", Georgia, serif); font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-tile-cue { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted, oklch(67% 0.015 260)); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-cue { color: var(--accent, oklch(81% 0.13 74)); }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Sticky translucent header with a blurred booth-black backdrop, amber brand tile, and tracked wordmark.
components.html: TopTracksLast.fm
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 24px; background: oklch(15% 0.008 262 / 0.72); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(28% 0.012 262)); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-tile { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(140deg, oklch(81% 0.13 74), oklch(72% 0.12 74)); } .ds-brand-word { color: var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.008 85)); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-header-link { color: var(--muted, oklch(67% 0.015 260)); font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-header-link:hover { color: var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.008 85)); } .ds-header-link:focus-visible { outline: none; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(81% 0.13 74 / 0.12); }

components.name: The Result Reveal
components.description: Signature pattern: the first answer rises in; every one after is handed off by dimming the outgoing result and scrolling the reader to the new one.
components.html: TOP TRACKParanoid Android12,480,113 plays
components.css: .ds-reveal { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 22px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, oklch(19% 0.012 262)); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -30px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.8); animation: ds-rise 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both; transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-reveal[data-stale="true"] { animation: none; opacity: 0.45; } .ds-reveal-label { color: var(--faint, oklch(62% 0.012 260)); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; } .ds-reveal-title { color: var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.008 85)); font-family: var(--font-display, "Instrument Serif", Georgia, serif); font-size: clamp(30px, 3.4vw, 40px); line-height: 1.04; } .ds-reveal-plays { color: var(--fg, oklch(94% 0.008 85)); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @keyframes ds-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-reveal { animation: none; } }

components.name: Skeleton Bar
components.description: Loading is a shimmer sweep across the shape of the answer to come — never a centered spinner.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 22px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, oklch(19% 0.012 262)); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -30px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.8); } .ds-skeleton-bar { display: block; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--surface-2, oklch(23% 0.014 262)) 0%, oklch(28% 0.014 262) 50%, var(--surface-2, oklch(23% 0.014 262)) 100%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-shimmer 1.35s linear infinite; } .ds-skeleton-bar--label { width: 30%; height: 9px; } .ds-skeleton-bar--title { width: 70%; height: 22px; } .ds-skeleton-bar--meta { width: 45%; } @keyframes ds-shimmer { from { background-position: 200% 0; } to { background-position: -200% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skeleton-bar { animation: none; background: var(--surface-2, oklch(23% 0.014 262)); } }

narrative.overview:
TopTracks looks and feels like the glow of a radio booth after hours: a dark, hushed field with a single warm amber light on the dial, and a host leaning in to play you a band's biggest track — then the one you should hear next. The surface recedes so the music can be the star. Type and artwork carry the emotion; everything else is quiet, atmospheric, and personal. The register is a tool that happens to look great: behavior follows product discipline (clarity, speed, honest states), while the identity stays intimate and a little cinematic.

The system is built on a near-black indigo canvas with warm ivory text and one confident amber accent. Serif display headings give each artist a marquee moment; a clean sans handles reading; a mono voices the small technical labels and numbers like a readout on equipment. Components are warm and tactile — generously rounded, soft-edged, springy on hover — so the interface invites a touch rather than holding you at arm's length.

What it explicitly rejects: the generic SaaS dashboard (identical card grids, hero-metric big-number tiles, corporate navy), anything sterile or flat that loses character, and loud neon maximalism. Warmth here is a single dial light, never a floodlight.
keyCharacteristics: Dark near-black indigo canvas; a single amber accent as the one warm signal.
Serif display for artist/track/album names; sans for reading; mono for labels and figures.
Generous 16px radii, soft diffuse shadows, and a subtle ambient glow layer.
Motion is felt through light and small lifts — a rising first reveal, a loading shimmer, and a scroll that carries the reader to each new answer.
Discovery-first: every result offers a doorway to the next search.

rules.name: The One Dial Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only warm light in the room. It marks the primary action, the current selection, and the headline figure — nothing decorative. If two amber elements compete for attention on a screen, one is wrong.

rules.name: The No Pure White Rule
rules.body: Text is warm Ivory (oklch 94%, hue 85), never `#fff`. Pure white on the near-black canvas reads clinical; the booth is warm.

rules.name: The Readable Floor Rule
rules.body: On this canvas, no text token goes below L=62% — that is where 4.5:1 runs out against Panel Raised, the lightest surface text sits on. Lightness is the only lever that buys contrast here; chroma and hue do not. The three text tiers (Ivory 94 → Muted 75 → Faint 62) are spaced to stay distinguishable above that floor. A dimmer tier is not available: if a design needs one, it needs less text, not fainter text.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Names Rule
rules.body: Display serif is for things with names — artists, tracks, albums, sections. Never set a UI label, button, or data figure in the serif; those belong to the sans and the mono.

rules.name: The Meter Rule
rules.body: Every number a user might compare (plays, listeners) is set in mono with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, so figures read like a physical readout.

rules.name: The Tone-First Rule
rules.body: Layering is done with lightness (Booth Black → Panel → Panel Raised), not with borders or heavy shadows. Shadows are diffuse ambient glow, never a crisp 2014-style drop shadow. If a shadow has a visible hard edge, it's wrong.

dos: Do keep Amber Dial as the only warm accent, on ≤10% of any screen (The One Dial Rule).
Do set every artist, track, album, and section name in Instrument Serif; keep UI labels and figures in Inter/JetBrains Mono (The Serif-For-Names Rule).
Do set all comparable numbers in mono with `tabular-nums` (The Meter Rule).
Do convey depth through tonal layering (Booth Black → Panel → Panel Raised) plus diffuse ambient glow (The Tone-First Rule).
Do use warm Ivory (oklch 94%, hue 85) for text, never pure white (The No Pure White Rule).
Do keep every text token at or above L=62%, the point where 4.5:1 runs out on Panel Raised (The Readable Floor Rule).
Do make every result offer a doorway to the next search — the similar-artist tiles are the discovery engine, not a footnote.
Do provide a `prefers-reduced-motion` alternative for the rise, the shimmer, and the reveal scroll.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no identical card grids, no hero-metric big-number tiles, no corporate navy.
Don't go sterile or flat — never strip the atmosphere down to characterless gray on a plain surface.
Don't go loud, neon, or maximalist: no gratuitous glow, motion overload, or glassmorphism-as-decoration. Warmth is a single dial light, not a floodlight.
Don't invent a text tier below Faint (L=62%) to push microcopy back — it cannot clear AA on any surface in this system (The Readable Floor Rule).
Don't use hardcoded hex; derive new shades from the OKLCH tokens.
Don't ship hard-edged 2014-style drop shadows; if a shadow has a crisp edge, the blur is too small.
Don't use a display serif for buttons, form labels, or data figures.
